items.title: Shipping JPEG XL in Chrome
items.summary: Chrome 155 ships decoding support for the JPEG XL image format, which offers 30-50% better compression than JPEG plus lossless compression, built-in HDR support, and lossless JPEG transcoding. The decoder is a pure Rust implementation (jxl-rs) chosen to eliminate memory-safety bugs at the source, with a SIMD abstraction layer keeping performance competitive with the C++ reference. The team says the decision came from consistent developer feedback, most visibly through the Interop 2026 process.

items.title: A font recreated from photographs of classic Commodore 64 keycaps
items.summary: An open-source font that recreates the lettering of classic Commodore 64 keycaps from photographs, with cleaned-up shapes and consistent proportions. It includes uppercase letters, numbers, punctuation, function-key labels f1-f12, and all 63 PETSCII graphic front legends, distributed as TTF, OTF, and webfont with editable outlines in the repo. The author notes it is a reconstruction rather than an exact photo trace, with proportions inferred from the keyboard photographs.

items.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
items.summary: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. Their work solved a century-old puzzle: how homochirality, life's use of just one mirror-image form of molecules like amino acids, can emerge spontaneously. Kagan's 1986 discovery made it possible to create a larger excess of one mirror image, and Soai's 2003 reaction produced essentially only one, a feat no one had achieved outside of life itself.
